newsitem.title: USA: Williams Cos files for Pocono expansion.
newsitem.headline: Williams Cos files for Pocono expansion.

text.p: Transcontinental Gas Pipe Line Corp (Transco), a unit of Williams Cos Inc, said on Friday it has filed an application with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) to expand capacity at a Pennsylvania pipeline.
The $9.8 million Pocono Expansion Project will involve the construction of approximately four miles of additional 36-inch loop to increase firm capacity on Transco's Leidy Line, the company said.
The targeted in-service date is Nov. 1, 1997.
Transco and its Pocono customers have executed precedent agreements for primary terms of up to twenty years for the full capacity of the project, Transco said.
Rates for the incrementally-priced project are expected to be approximately $4.85 per dekatherm per month for the new firm transportation capacity created on the Leidy Line, Transco said.
